theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [TopologicalSpace X] [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X] [SigmaCompactSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (N : ℕ) (L : C_c(X, Rn N) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ), (∀ K : Set X, IsCompact K → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ f : C_c(X, Rn N), (∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ 1) → tsupport f ⊆ K → L f ≤ C) → ∃ (μ : Measure X) (ν : X → Rn N), (∀ K : Set X, IsCompact K → μ K < ∞) ∧ StronglyMeasurable ν ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖ν x‖ = 1) ∧ ∀ f : C_c(X, Rn N), L f = ∫ x, inner ℝ (f x) (ν x) ∂μ
